celtics.definition: n. a branch of the Indo-European languages that (judging from inscriptions and place names) was spread widely over Europe in the pre-Christian era

celties.translation: 斜纹板司呢, 方块斜纹织物

celtis occidentalis.translation: [网络] 美洲朴；朴树类；朴木

celts.definition: n a member of a European people who once occupied Britain and Spain and Gaul prior to Roman times
celts.translation: n. [考古]史前期的石斧；凯尔特人（Celt的复数）

celtuce.definition:
n. lettuce valued especially for its edible stems
n. leaves having celery-like stems eaten raw or cooked
